commands.description: Pending incoming contact requests

commands.description: Reject a pending contact request

commands.description: Block a peer here and at the home relay

commands.name: unblock
commands.description: Remove a block

commands.description: Delegation credentials: an issuer declares that a subject acts on its behalf (grants no authority)

options.description: Thread ID

commands.description: Received messages (pulls the relay first unless a receiver is running)

commands.description: Unread messages (all with --all)

Only this type

commands.description: Queued sends and their delivery status

commands.description: Every entry: pending, delivered, rejected or expired (stopped retrying, outcome unknown; a late receipt still settles it)

commands.description: Attempt one pending entry now, or every due one

commands.description: Stop retrying an entry: it becomes expired (outcome unknown; a late receipt still settles it)

commands.description: Receive continuously: follow the relay, send receipts, retry the outbox, renew descriptor, prekey and permits
